name: Matrix Zero Divisors
text: For all 2x2 integer matrices A and B, if A*B = 0 then A = 0 or B = 0.

name: Matrix Non-Commutativity
text: For all 2x2 integer matrices A and B, A*B = B*A.

name: Orthogonal Idempotents
text: If P^2 = P and Q^2 = Q and P + Q = 1, then P*Q = 0.

name: Nilpotent Invertibility
text: If a^2 = 0 in a ring, then 1 + a != 0.

name: Euler Polynomial Prime Generation
text: The polynomial n^2 - n + 41 produces primes for all integers n.

name: Sum of Two Squares Congruence
text: An integer of the form 4k + 3 cannot be written as a sum of two squares.

name: Fermat Pseudoprime Composite
text: If 2^(n-1) = 1 mod n for n > 1, then n is strictly prime.

name: Goldbach Decomposition for 10
text: The even integer 10 can be partitioned as the sum of two odd primes.

name: Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality R^3
text: For all vectors x, y in R^3, (x.y)^2 <= ||x||^2 * ||y||^2.

name: AM-GM Inequality 2D
text: For all non-negative real numbers a and b, (a + b)/2 >= sqrt(a*b).

name: Strict Quadratic Convexity
text: The quadratic form x^2 - 4xy + 5y^2 is non-negative for all real x, y.

name: Non-Convex Global Potential Minimum
text: The polynomial potential f(x) = x^4 - 2x^2 + 1 is bounded below by 0.

name: Graph Chromatic Lower Bound
text: Every finite graph with minimum degree delta >= 3 has chromatic number >= 4.

name: Ramsey Lower Bound R(3,3) > 5
text: There exists a 2-coloring of the complete graph K_5 without any monochromatic triangle.

name: Ramsey Upper Bound R(3,3) <= 6
text: Every 2-coloring of the complete graph K_6 contains at least one monochromatic triangle.

name: Pigeonhole Principle Collisions
text: Assigning 5 items into 4 distinct bins must result in at least one collision.

name: De Morgan Duality Theorem
text: In propositional logic, ~(A & B) is logically equivalent to (~A | ~B).

name: Modus Ponens Rule Soundness
text: Given premise A and implication (A => B), conclusion B holds soundly.

name: Affirming the Consequent Fallacy
text: Given premise B and implication (A => B), conclusion A is deductive.

name: Peirce Classical Logic Law
text: The proposition ((P => Q) => P) => P is universally valid in classical logic.
